flavor: A pale, bloated 僵尸 sits atop a velvet-draped pedestal, meticulously polishing a single, glistening 樱桃. As you approach, the creature gestures toward a heavy, iron-bound script lying open on the floor, signaling that the next scene of your journey is ready to be 上演.
name: The Crimson Stagehand
reason: The party encounters a soul-bound entity offering a shortcut through the upcoming chamber in exchange for a portion of their vitality.
